papers.title: Advances in Agentic Computer Graphics
papers.desc: Computer graphics is built on code.

papers.title: SWE-Trail: History-Guided Trajectory Collection for Coding Agent Training
papers.desc: Coding agents solve repository issues through long sequences of exploration, editing, and validation.

papers.title: PhotoGuider: Composition-Aware Cropping and 360^{circ} View Framing with Explainable Photographic Assessments
papers.desc: Traditional image cropping assumes the photograph already contains the composition worth keeping, and asks only where to crop.

papers.title: When Does Latent Prediction Error Support Physical Surprise Claims in Video World Models?
papers.desc: Prediction errors from video world models are often treated as physical surprise, but they can also reflect appearance, static content, motion, or ordinary prediction difficulty.

papers.title: Order-Only On-Policy Distillation
papers.desc: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student on its own generations by matching the teacher's token probabilities.

papers.title: IdeaTaste: Do LLMs Share the Research Taste of Human Researchers?
papers.desc: Research taste, the judgment of what to read, which problems to pursue, and which methods to try, increasingly shapes the work of AI scientists, yet it remains far less understood than their ability to execute research.

papers.title: LEANGUARD: Lean-Verified Guardrails for Tool-Using Agents
papers.desc: Tool-using language-model agents often execute actions that their domain policies forbid.

papers.title: Multi-Agent Relay Thinking
papers.desc: Existing multi-agent collaboration (MAC) methods have primarily explored a group thinking collaboration topology, where agents independently generate solutions and aggregate their outputs.

papers.title: Cross-Primitive Consistency in Jev
papers.desc: Jev enables efficient decision-making with large language models (LLMs) through typed querying primitives, allowing the same semantic state to be expressed in different formats, such as binary and multiple-choice queries.

papers.title: Advancing SVD-based LLM Compression via Layer-Wise Error Model Search
papers.desc: Low-rank SVD-based compression offers a powerful strategy to reduce the computational costs of LLMs.

papers.title: DR Pixel: Page-Native Deep Research with Vision-Language Models
papers.desc: Complex documents such as scientific papers contain rich information in tables, figures, and equations; however, existing deep research (DR) agents typically reduce papers to OCR-extracted text.

papers.title: Can Large Language Model Agents Learn by Watching Tutorial Videos?
papers.desc: Humans continuously acquire knowledge from carefully crafted materials such as books and tutorial videos, carrying that understanding into future tasks.

papers.title: DAMI: Dual-Axis Memory Initialization for Enhanced Long-Context Retrieval in Gated Linear Attention
papers.desc: Linear attention scales linearly with sequence length, but its finite-state memory can limit long-context retrieval.

papers.title: Where Do Vision Language Models Fail at 3D Reasoning?
papers.desc: Vision-language models can get individual judgments right while struggling to recover and consistently use the exact properties of a 3D object.

papers.title: TaoMate-FVSR:Audio-Guided Facial Video Restoration
papers.desc: AI-generated videos often depict people within detailed scenes while leaving their small facial regions poorly resolved.
